name: GE HealthCare Technologies
description: GE HealthCare makes the machines hospitals use to see inside patients (MRI, CT, X-ray, ultrasound, molecular imaging), patient monitors and life-support equipment, and the contrast agents and radioactive tracers injected for scans. The money is a one-time equipment sale, then service contracts and software, plus consumable drugs sold per scan. The pharmaceutical diagnostics business is about 14 percent of revenue but 28 percent of segment profit. No single customer is over 10 percent of revenue; China is about 10 percent of revenue and falling. In Q2 2026 it merged its Imaging and Advanced Visualization segments into one.

businessLines.name: Imaging (radiology: MR, CT, X-ray, molecular imaging)
businessLines.how: Large equipment sales to hospitals and imaging centres (priced per scanner), followed by multi-year service contracts and software upgrades; hospital capital budgets and tariffs affect margin.
businessLines.description: Reported as its own segment in FY2025; from Q2 2026 called Radiology inside Advanced Imaging Solutions.

operatingProfit.label: Segment EBIT (excludes restructuring, amortization of acquired intangibles, separation costs)

businessLines.name: Advanced Visualization Solutions (AVS)
businessLines.how: Ultrasound systems and probes sold to clinics and hospitals, and image-guided surgery systems sold to interventional rooms, with service and software attached.
businessLines.description: Procedural guidance (surgical and interventional) and specialized ultrasound (women's health, cardiology, point-of-care).

operatingProfit.label: Segment EBIT (excludes restructuring, amortization of acquired intangibles, separation costs)

businessLines.name: Patient Care Solutions (PCS)
businessLines.how: Bedside monitors and life-support devices sold to hospitals in volume, plus disposables and service.
businessLines.description: Monitoring solutions and life support solutions (ventilators, anesthesia, infant care).

operatingProfit.label: Segment EBIT (excludes restructuring, amortization of acquired intangibles, separation costs)

businessLines.name: Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx)
businessLines.how: Consumable drugs bought per patient scan by hospitals and imaging centres; recurring and tied to scan volumes. Highest margin line.
businessLines.description: Contrast media for CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound and radiopharmaceutical tracers for molecular imaging.

operatingProfit.label: Segment EBIT (excludes restructuring, amortization of acquired intangibles, separation costs)

businessLines.name: Other (HealthCare Financial Services)
businessLines.how: Customer financing; not an operating segment.

operatingProfit.label: Segment EBIT (excludes restructuring, amortization of acquired intangibles, separation costs)
